about.en: MUSE Lab stands for **Multimodal Understanding and Synthesis for Explainability**. The Muses were the Greek goddesses of art and inspiration: we want generative AI to be just as creative, and at the same time **controllable, interpretable and trustworthy**.
about.zh: MUSE Lab 的全称是 **Multimodal Understanding and Synthesis for Explainability**，即“面向可解释性的多模态理解与生成”。MUSE 也是希腊神话中司掌艺术与灵感的缪斯女神：我们希望生成式 AI 像缪斯一样富有创造力，同时**可控、可解释、值得信任**。

about.en: The lab is led by [Yifan Yuan](./).
about.zh: 实验室负责人是[袁一帆](./)。

text.en: Images, video and language, modelled together.
text.zh: 联合建模图像、视频与语言。

text.en: Knowing what a model sees, and why it fails.
text.zh: 看懂模型理解了什么、为什么会出错。

text.en: Generating and editing content with precise control.
text.zh: 精确、可控地生成与编辑内容。

text.en: Opening the black box, so that people can trust it.
text.zh: 打开黑箱，让人能够信任。

summary.en: From models that can generate to models you can trust: grounded, self-aware and correctable.
summary.zh: 让多模态大模型与扩散模型从“能够生成”走向“可信生成”。

topics.zh: 幻觉风险的预测与干预
可信的大模型与智能体

cover.alt: Flux images for fixed concepts: correct ink sketches of grapes, vintage photos of trains and pink bananas, but repeated failures for cakes, LEGO and carrots

caption.en: Object-dependent concept brittleness: for a fixed concept, Flux succeeds on most objects but keeps failing on a few semantically related ones, whatever the random seed.
caption.zh: 物体依赖的概念脆弱性：同一个概念，Flux 对大多数物体都能画对，却在少数语义相关的物体上反复失败，换随机种子也一样。

summary.en: Models that understand video, images and text, put to work on real tasks.
summary.zh: 让模型读懂视频、图像与文字，并落到真实场景中。

topics.zh: 视频时刻检索与高光检测

caption.en: SurveyGraph in three phases: building the methods–entity knowledge graph, writing the survey along it, and evaluating the result with several models.
caption.zh: SurveyGraph 的三个阶段：构建方法—实体知识图谱，沿图谱生成综述，再由多个模型综合评估。

caption.zh: 知识图谱的结构：一篇论文与前序工作、基线、被引文献的关系，以及与方法、任务、数据集、指标的关系。
